record.body:
## Description

The Needs you tab counts only items whose subject is a task slug, so it disagrees with the panel. Remove the tab: six tabs on keys 1-6, and the panel border title shows the item count. Update bindings, --once output, README, and tests that walk tabs.

payload.title: Remove the Needs you status tab and count items in the panel title

record.subject: needs-you-tab-removal
